cairo.name: Cairo & Giza
activities: Explore the Giza pyramids and the Great Sphinx
Discover ancient treasures at the Grand Egyptian Museum
Wander Khan el-Khalili and pause for Egyptian coffee
Explore Coptic Cairo and its historic lanes
Visit the Step Pyramid at Saqqara
Taste Egyptian classics on a relaxed local food walk
Enjoy an unhurried evening beside the Nile

luxor.name: Luxor
activities: Explore the vast columns and courtyards of Karnak
Discover the Valley of the Kings on the west bank
Experience Luxor Temple as the afternoon light softens
Walk along the Nile with views of the west bank
Leave an afternoon free for the pool or the riverside
Browse a local market and enjoy a leisurely Egyptian dinner

aswan.name: Aswan
activities: Visit the island sanctuary of Philae Temple
Take a felucca sail on the Nile, weather permitting
Discover Nubian culture with a locally guided village visit
Enjoy a slow afternoon beside the Nile
Set aside a full day for an early road excursion to Abu Simbel
Explore Aswan’s souk at your own pace
Visit the gardens of Kitchener’s Island

redsea.name: Red Sea
activities: Settle into a leisurely beach day in Hurghada
Join a guided Red Sea snorkeling excursion, conditions permitting
Enjoy a free day at your resort
Explore Hurghada’s marina and find a spot for dinner
Discover the coast on a boat excursion, conditions permitting
Make time for a spa visit or a quiet afternoon by the water

desert.name: White Desert
activities: Travel with a licensed desert operator to the White Desert’s chalk formations
Explore the Black Desert and Crystal Mountain with a local guide
Watch the light change across the desert at sunset
Spend an evening stargazing at a permitted camp
Pause in Bahariya Oasis and learn about oasis life

alexandria.name: Alexandria
activities: Explore the Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa
Visit the seafront Citadel of Qaitbay
Discover the Bibliotheca Alexandrina, subject to opening hours
Stroll the Corniche and linger over a seaside lunch
Explore Alexandria’s cafés and Mediterranean character

egypt-unfolded.name: Egypt, unfolded
egypt-unfolded.description: The icons you dream of. The moments you don’t expect.
egypt-unfolded.detail: From the pyramids to the temples of Upper Egypt, follow a thoughtfully paced route through Egypt’s most enduring wonders. Leave room for a market detour, a quiet courtyard and the soft light on the Nile.
highlights: Days 1–3|Cairo, Giza, ancient treasures and local life
Days 4–5|Travel to Luxor; discover its east and west banks
Days 6–7|Travel to Aswan; Philae and a gentler rhythm on the Nile

nile.name: Along the timeless Nile
nile.description: Temple mornings. Felucca afternoons. No need to rush.
nile.detail: A land-based journey between Luxor and Aswan, with temple visits and time by the river. Add a felucca sail and discover the cultures that give the Nile its character.
highlights: Days 1–2|Luxor’s temples and the west bank
Day 3|Travel south to Aswan and settle in
Days 4–5|Philae Temple, Nubian culture and a felucca sail

desert.name: Where the world falls quiet
desert.description: Otherworldly landscapes. A sky full of possibility.
desert.detail: Leave Cairo for Bahariya Oasis and an expedition among the White Desert’s chalk formations. Designed with a licensed local desert operator, with camping and access subject to permits and conditions.
highlights: Day 1|Transfer from Cairo to Bahariya Oasis
Day 2|Guided desert exploration, sunset and permitted camping
Day 3|A slow morning and return transfer to Cairo

red-sea.name: A different shade of blue
red-sea.description: Clear water, sun-warmed days, and room to exhale.
red-sea.detail: A gentle coastal escape based in Hurghada. Choose relaxed beach days, guided snorkeling or a little of both. Boat trips and water activities depend on conditions and local availability.
highlights: Day 1|Arrive and settle into life by the water
Days 2–4|Beach time, optional snorkeling and a marina evening
Day 5|One last slow morning before departure

giza-day.name: An audience with eternity
giza-day.description: Meet the pyramids. See history on a different scale.
giza-day.detail: A focused day on the Giza Plateau, with time for the pyramids, the Sphinx and a relaxed Egyptian lunch. An ideal starting point for a first visit to Cairo.
highlights: Morning|The pyramids of Giza and panoramic viewpoints
Midday|The Great Sphinx and time for lunch
Afternoon|Return to your Cairo base

cairo-day.name: The soul of old Cairo
cairo-day.description: Winding lanes, glowing lanterns, stories at every turn.
cairo-day.detail: Discover Cairo through its everyday textures. Explore historic lanes, browse Khan el-Khalili and pause for coffee and Egyptian flavors along the way.
highlights: Morning|A walk through historic Cairo and Al-Muizz Street
Afternoon|Khan el-Khalili and a local lunch
Late afternoon|An unhurried coffee stop before returning

luxor-day.name: A day among the pharaohs
luxor-day.description: Tombs, temples, and a thousand reasons to look up.
luxor-day.detail: A full day based in Luxor, linking selected west-bank highlights with Karnak on the east bank. Start early, allow time for lunch and choose fewer stops if you prefer a slower pace.
highlights: Early morning|Valley of the Kings
Late morning|Temple of Hatshepsut and lunch
Afternoon|Karnak Temple before returning to your Luxor base

alex-day.name: Alexandria, a sea change
alex-day.description: Mediterranean air and another side of Egypt.
alex-day.detail: A long day trip from Cairo to Egypt’s Mediterranean city. Begin early for the road journey, explore the catacombs and Qaitbay’s waterfront, and leave time for a seaside lunch before the return drive.
highlights: Early morning|Road transfer from Cairo to Alexandria
Daytime|Catacombs, the Qaitbay waterfront and seaside lunch
Evening|Return drive to Cairo
